title: FedV-KGQA: Multi-Hop Question Answering over Vertically Partitioned Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.24846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world data for knowledge graph question answering is often distributed across different organizations due to governance and data sovereignty constraints. While centralized systems exist, they cannot answer multi-hop questions when the required facts are split across vertically partitioned silos. In this paper, we propose FedV-KGQA, a framework for multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs in which organizations share entities but own disjoint sets of relations. Our approach combines local graph enrichment and knowledge graph embeddings to ensure raw triples and relation parameters never leave each silo, establishing a structural data boundary without requiring centralized graph access. We further introduce a topic entity anchoring mechanism that grounds questions in the correct graph neighborhood without any runtime inter-silo communication. translated_title: FedV-KGQA：面向垂直分区知识图谱的多跳问答
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24846v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现实世界中的知识图谱问答数据往往因治理和数据主权限制而分布在不同的组织之间。尽管存在集中式系统，但当所需事实分散在垂直分区的数据孤岛中时，它们无法回答多跳问题。在本文中，我们提出了FedV-KGQA，一个用于知识图谱多跳推理的框架，其中各组织共享实体但拥有不相交的关系集。我们的方法结合了局部图增强和知识图谱嵌入，以确保原始三元组和关系参数永远不会离开各自的数据孤岛，从而在不需集中式图访问的情况下建立结构数据边界。我们还引入了一种主题实体锚定机制，该机制在无需运行时跨孤岛通信的情况下将问题定位到正确的图邻域。我们在三个基准上评估了12种模型配置，并表明FedV-KGQA表现良好。
tldr: 本文提出了FedV-KGQA框架，通过结合局部图增强和知识图谱嵌入，在不跨孤岛通信的情况下实现垂直分区知识图谱的多跳问答，并引入主题实体锚定机制来确保数据隐私和推理准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedV-KGQA, a framework that combines local graph enrichment and knowledge graph embeddings to enable multi-hop question answering over vertically partitioned knowledge graphs without inter-silo communication, introducing a topic entity anchoring mechanism to ensure data privacy and reasoning accuracy.
